integrity: The source balancing equations and type-polytope normalization are reconstructed directly. Two-face balancing collapses the edge weights to one coordinate per simplex factor, after which an explicit isometry to a weighted coordinate simplex gives every intrinsic facet distance. Equating those distances proves the incenter and inradius formulas; pairwise vertex distances give the regularity criterion for at least three factors. Finite optimization replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the canonical normalized edge-Minkowski-weight embedding of the standard product of standard simplices and assumes at least two factors. The primary source proves simplex combinatorics for every realization of the product type, but the Euclidean metric formula here is realization-sensitive. The minimum enclosing ball, volume, and extremal ellipsoids are not determined.
title: Product-of-simplices type polytopes have an exact edge-weight inball
